subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: Only the real configured operator's latest authenticated exact-head review and verified mainline artifact authorize a lock; installed Forgejo uses P-9's trusted repository governance and GitHub retains its existing enforced approval behavior.
fit_criterion: Positive native human-review/artifact receipt; native unapproved/stale/agent/rejected/changed-head/ambiguous-review fixtures proving zero lock-tag writes; valid Forgejo preparation without a protection-policy endpoint; existing GitHub approval/protection regression evidence; independent post-merge review and content checks; synthetic reviews only in tests
